correctness.rationale: For all integers n>=3, explicit formula (1) for both shores of U(X) yields an exhaustive, disjoint nonfull-image partition H_n=2^(n+1)+n²-n-3 and exactly 2n distinct two-nonfull complementary image pairs. Their union plus central gives 4·2^n+2n²-5. The noncentral 4n fiber sizes follow from direct binomial enumeration; mass balance gives the central fiber. Separate n=1,2 boundaries. Verification independently built the graph closed neighborhoods, enumerated all 2^(2n) subsets through n=9, tested the whole image/fiber spectrum and the undeleted comparison; output VERIFY_OK family_cases=15 crown_subsets=349524. This finite testing is corroboration, not the all-n proof.

value.rationale: The natural all-subset lower/upper rough-image map for a graph measures the number of distinct approximations and how many source subsets collapse to each. A sparse structural perturbation, deleting exactly n edges from K_n,n, has a provable quadratic 2n² change in distinct observations and an exact, highly nonuniform collision spectrum (central versus 4n special fibers). This gives sharp comparison and full finite-family classification unavailable from the undeleted graph formula, not an arbitrary numerical slice. It makes no unproved downstream-application claims.
